# SurfKarnataka

SurfKarnataka (Surf Karnataka) is a surf school in Gokarna, Karnataka, India, offering surfing lessons and guided surfing sessions on the coast of the Arabian Sea. It serves beginners, intermediate surfers, private one-to-one sessions and group sessions for travellers visiting Gokarna and coastal Karnataka.

## Pages

- Home: overview of the surf school, experiences, location in Gokarna and how to book via WhatsApp — /
- Surf Lessons: details of beginner, intermediate, private and group surfing sessions plus the learning journey — /surf-lessons
- About Us: the story, surfing philosophy and teaching approach of SurfKarnataka — /about
- Gallery: photos of surfing, lessons, students, instructors and the Gokarna coast — /gallery
- Contact: business details, directions and an enquiry form that continues on WhatsApp — /contact

## Booking

All bookings and enquiries are handled through WhatsApp. A WhatsApp enquiry is not a confirmed reservation; availability and confirmation are handled directly by the business.
